rules.rule: Do not add a bare 'except:' or 'except Exception: pass'.
Use the logging module, not print, in application code.
Do not build SQL with f-strings, % or .format(); pass query parameters.
Do not use a list, dict or set as a default argument value.
New public functions have type hints on parameters and return value.
Every requests or httpx call passes a timeout.
Do not add API keys, tokens or passwords as string literals.
